image_description: A circular aneroid barometer with a brass/gold-colored casing and dial face. The main dial shows atmospheric pressure in inches of mercury (28-31 range visible) with a red pointer hand. There's a smaller sub-dial at the bottom showing humidity percentage (0-100) with a black pointer. The dial has weather indicators like 'Change', 'Rain', 'Fair', 'Set', 'Very Dry'. The brand 'GENERAL' is visible in the center. The instrument has a glass cover with visible reflections.
